pages.title: Unbihexium Ingot
pages.text: Element 126, the heart of the island of stability, where magic numbers for both protons and neutrons line up. Nothing this heavy should last; this does. Its surface is a dull silver that seems to swallow light.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Flerovium on its own is only the shore of the island. Pushing further meant adding supernova debris, positronium hydride to supply energy and quark-gluon plasma for neutrons. The Nuclide Forge produced element 126 and it stayed.
Made in $(item)Nuclide Forge$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Island of Stability.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Dimensional Residue, Hypernova Alloy Ingot, Panspermia Seed.
